name: Provide instructions for installing software and operating systems
description: Users asked for step-by-step instructions to install, configure, or set up operating systems, software applications, system utilities, and hardware drivers across various platforms. These requests often involved specific technical contexts, such as preparing bootable media, managing package dependencies, or troubleshooting installation errors on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
